title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to develop inclusive, sustainable and resilient skills and lifelong learning systems

description.narrative: The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Identification of critical knowledge gaps in skills and lifelong learning and develop, management and sharing of innovative knowledge products together with constituents for the effective skilling, reskilling and upskilling of workers, focusing on skills anticipation. (2) Research on the changing demand for skills and lifelong learning and on the financing of lifelong learning. (3) Initiatives to promote skills for trade and economic diversification and for just transitions and green jobs, for workers in the informal economy, and for people in vulnerable and crisis situations. (4) Scaling up of capacity development interventions for governments and social partners and others in collaboration with the Turin Centre, ILO–CINTERFOR, regional and national institutions and online learning platforms. (5) Strengthening of strategic partnerships with development partners including UN agencies, international financial institutions, the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development, the Global Partnership for Education, the African Union Commission, the European Commission and other regional intergovernmental organizations.
